verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Crossmint is an API platform, and versioning plus a deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The pack documents many REST APIs and an API reference, but says nothing about API versioning schemes or a deprecation policy. The lone "no webhooks in v1" remark describes a release of the Agent Checkouts product, not a versioned API with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
